x-card.description: Indexes and records of Pinecone: metadata-filtered fetches, nearest-neighbour search by vector, record or text with integrated embedding. Upserts and deletes wait for approval.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. The project's key: ControlPlaneViewer finds the indexes, DataPlaneViewer reads them; agents that upsert and delete need DataPlaneEditor.

collections.title: Indexes
collections.description: The indexes agents may use; * matches any characters, such as products_*. Empty: every index the credentials see.
